Title: Deep
Director: Sita Likitvanichkul, Jetarin Ratanaserikiat, Apirak Samudkidpisan
Writer: Sita Likitvanichkul, Kittitat Nokngam, Jetarin Ratanaserikiat
Actors: Panisara Rikulsurakan, Kay Lertsittichai, Supanaree Sutavijitvong
Plot: Four insomniac med school students are lured into a neuroscience experiment that spirals out of control and must find a way out before it's too late.
